name: zfmv_script_init
description: zFMV_Script::Init initializes script window/list state, enables abort-on-key, optionally loads FMV actions, and returns this.
binary_ninja_evidence: 0x4625e0 stores hWnd when non-null, otherwise stores g_RecoilApp_hWndMain into m_hWnd.
It clears m_fmvPath, m_head, m_tail, and m_cur, sets m_abortOnKey to 1, returns self, and cleans up the three stack arguments.
It calls zFMV_Script::LoadActionsFromZrd only when both zrdPath and tagPrefix are non-null; the callee is functionally accepted by zfmv_script_load_actions_from_zrd.
